items.title: File Einspruch against the Arbeitnehmer-Sparzulage assessment
items.quote: Wer mit dieser Festsetzung nicht einverstanden ist, kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch beim Finanzamt Musterwiesen erheben
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 21.12.2026, sent by ordinary post by a tax office, so it counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting under §122 Abs.2 Nr.1 AO: that would be Fri 25.12.2026, which is a public holiday (1. Weihnachtstag) in NW, so delivery shifts to the next working day, Mon 28.12.2026 (§108 Abs.3 AO). The one-month Einspruchsfrist starts the day after delivery (§187 Abs.1 BGB, §108 Abs.1 AO) and ends one month later on the same-numbered day (§188 Abs.2 BGB): Thu 28.01.2027, which is a regular working day, so it stands.

warnings: The 43,00 € Arbeitnehmer-Sparzulage is not paid to Herr Musterschmidt directly but credited to his Bausparvertrag once the Sperrfrist has ended, so no payment or claim action is needed from him unless he disputes the assessed amount.
The sender's name and Finanzamt letterhead details (address, phone, email, IBAN) appear internally consistent; no mismatch or suspicious payment request was found in this letter.
